summary: Implemented `v2-cycle-03-product-span-retrieval`: mixed work/product lines can now produce one additive product-bearing retrieval alternate, while original-query retrieval, reranking, result query, limits, and selection semantics remain unchanged. Marked all OpenSpec tasks complete.
tests: python -m pytest -q tests/test_query_canonicalization.py tests/test_hybrid_retriever.py tests/test_matcher.py -> 30 passed
mechanism_evidence: Eligible action-plus-product clauses emit a distinct alternate starting at the supported product anchor and retaining product, DN/PN, connection, material, and control evidence.
Service-only, non-action product, and separated action/product examples preserve existing canonicalization behavior without product inference.
Matcher test verifies the product span is passed only as `canonical_query`; `MatchResult.query` and reranker input remain the normalized original query.
Existing hybrid retriever tests verify one extra distinct alternate call, deduplication/RRF behavior, and fail-open behavior when alternate retrieval fails.
Service-only work cue test verifies no path returns `NOT_FOUND` solely because work wording is present.
